driver_first_version_ram_boot_70.cause: SM5705 MUIC: CTRL 0x02 = 0x1e (automatic switching on), MANSW1 0x13 = 0x00 (D+/D- switch open), charger type unknown; writing MANSW1 = 0x24 and clearing the automatic-switch bit made the hub (14cd:8601) and its billboard device enumerate within a second, charging unchanged
